name: The Investment Trust Of India Limited

facts.business: The Investment Trust of India Limited is a financial services group operating through subsidiaries in NBFC vehicle financing, equity broking, wealth management, asset management, and alternate funds management.
key_risks: Asset quality pressures in unsecured lending segments
